title: AI Context Flow MCP
lede: AI Context Flow 2.0 runs one memory store as an MCP server, so Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other clients read and write the same context, sorted into per-project buckets with a full edit history.

points: Version 2.0 adds an MCP server: connect once and any MCP client works from the same saved context, so a brief saved in Claude is there in ChatGPT.
Buckets group memory by project, client or brand, and each bucket has its own access list.
Every edit is kept in version history, so a change made by an agent or a teammate can be rolled back.
Memory Studio is a single view for browsing, sorting, filtering and editing everything stored.
A commenter asks whether bucket permissions bind agents as well as people; the material does not answer it.

sections.text: The launch comment names heavy users of several AI tools, consultants and agencies working across multiple clients, and marketing teams running AI through shared workflows.
Every signup starts with a 7-day free trial, and the launch comment offers 20% off an annual plan until 30 November 2026. Plan prices are not given.
